output.reason: [ev-110340e9c914] says cert-manager changed the `PathType` of the Ingress routes it creates for ACME HTTP01 challenges to `Exact`. That is wire-level path-matching behaviour, so protocol-behavior "http01-ingress-pathtype" is the right subject, and behavior-changed with after "Exact" is the right change. The excerpt names `ImplementationSpecific` only as the kind of parsing the change avoids, not as the earlier value. So leaving "before" out is safer than value-changed, which needs both a before and an after value.
